name: lemon_prank
style: Photoreal candid home video, warm sunlit kitchen, big window behind them, soft natural light, shallow depth of field, 35mm look, slight handheld drift, family vlog feel. Two chubby toddler siblings at a small wooden table: the older sister, about four, round rosy cheeks, two little pigtails, mint-green pyjamas; the younger brother, about two, very round bald head, chubby arms, pale yellow pyjamas with a bib. Same faces, same clothes, same kitchen in every shot. No text, no subtitles.
shots: Medium close-up across the table. The sister holds a bright lemon slice up to her brother's mouth, grinning wide with her eyebrows raised, nodding encouragingly as if to say it is sweet, barely holding in a giggle. The brother leans in, hesitant, eyes flicking from the lemon to his sister, then slowly opens his mouth. Camera: slow push-in on the two faces. Audio: quiet kitchen room tone, a fridge hum, the sister stifling a laugh.

Continue the same scene, same two children, same kitchen: the brother bites down on the lemon. His whole round face crumples instantly, eyes squeezing shut into slits, lips puckering, a full-body shiver running through his shoulders. The sister explodes into laughter, slapping the table with both hands and sliding sideways off her chair. Camera: locked close-up, then a small handheld jolt with her laugh. Audio: a long high toddler whine, palms slapping wood, a shrieking little-girl laugh.

Continue the same scene, same two children, same kitchen: still laughing, the sister picks up a second lemon slice and takes a confident show-off bite. Her grin freezes, then her whole face screws up, cheeks sucking in, eyes watering. Now the brother is the one laughing, rocking back in his chair and pushing another lemon slice toward her with a chubby hand. Camera: slow pull back to hold both of them. Audio: laughter cutting off mid-breath, a squeak, then a delighted belly laugh from the little boy.
